body.objective: Generalize the fixture-level Taub sign pattern into a structural harmonic theorem identifying when the pure additional-Weyl energy form is definite, when the Einstein-image sector supplies the opposite sign, and how fixed versus variable Maxwell charges change the second-order cone.
body.stop_condition: State checkable background, harmonic, parity, and charge-fibre hypotheses; derive the obstruction bilinear and its inertia on generic ell>=2, exceptional ell=1, homogeneous, twist, and opposite-momentum blocks; and prove the sign/cancellation theorem or exhibit the first exact counterexample family. Connect each conclusion to existing atlas rows with independent controls.
body.current_gate: one theorem beyond the special compact fixtures explaining the observed Taub sign split
body.forbid: no universal sign theorem from selected ell=2 fixtures; no reduced-Hessian sign called a quantum norm; no bounded or all-order continuation inferred from moment-map cancellation; no arbitrary-background promotion
body.resource_hint: GENERALIZATION LANE requested by the review board. Prefer representation-theoretic and moment-map arguments over enumerating additional fixtures.
